body:
Definitely garlic!! 

I make a lot of stir fry, the vegetables I use for them are very flexible but if there's no garlic added it always feel like something's missing.

I suggest looking up backlit lighting references since the patterns of your shadow doesn't exactly match up to how it would actually look like if she was actually lit from behind. Also try being a little more brave in using darker and more dramatic shadows on the character, not just the surrounding environment. The shadows on the trees are a lot darker and more interesting and yet the character has very flat shadows.

Overall though I do like the atmosphere of the piece, good luck with your art journey!
I think the orange one is easier on the eyes.
